mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25% over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% signals a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5 over a 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST > 550) and retail sales (RSAFS > 360000) indicates robust consumer demand and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS growth fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of cases over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL < 2.0% annualized change), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as growth expectations rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 2.0% over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS > 130000) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive (12-month change > 0) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 600 (thousand units) signals strong residential construction activity that drives economic momentum, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 600 over a 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in industrial production (INDPRO > 92.0) and payroll growth (PAYEMS > 130000) indicates synchronized manufacturing and labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO and PAYEMS growth fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of cases over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP exceeding 13200 billion dollars (GDPC1 > 13200) indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 > 13200 over a 2-year rolling window.
